description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related functions for gathering system information such as CPU load, memory, hostname, and system version across different platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows). It also includes functions for setting environment variables and rebooting the system.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as hostname, CPU load, memory, and system version, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Reads and stores memory information from /proc/meminfo on Linux systems.

methods.name: ConstructUniqueId
methods.description: Constructs a unique identifier string based on device ID and system prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID based on device ID and system prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SystemInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes system info, including hostname and CPU stats.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateCpuStats
methods.description: Updates CPU load statistics based on platform-specific data sources.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateRealtimeInfo
methods.description: Updates real-time system info such as memory and uptime.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system timezone environment variable.

methods.name: System::Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system by executing /sbin/reboot on Unix-like systems.
